series.title: Park Ranger
series.statusStatement: Active (EMST OPM series register, as of 2026-10-23).
series.educationNote: from EMST's series record; not yet checked against the OPM qualification standard, so confirm with the HR office

generalCompetencies: not mapped in this release (X9 USA Hire and FWCI parts not built; WP-09 open item 6)

roles.functionStatement: Keep park visitors safe and informed while protecting the resources and experiences the park exists for.

x4.reviewStatus: unreviewed agent candidate (not reviewed by a person)

bands.indicativeBand: GS-5 to GS-7 (entry); GS-9 to GS-11 (journey)

majorDuties.duty: Provide visitor information, orientation and safety messaging in parks and protected areas

tasks.statement: Orient visitors at a contact station to routes, conditions, regulations and hazards matched to their plans and abilities
Give safety information and trip recommendations tailored to current conditions and each visitor's stated plans
Log visitor questions, incidents and concerns to identify information gaps and revise visitor messaging
Check visitor information from automated or online sources against current site conditions before it is posted or repeated to visitors

majorDuties.duty: Plan and manage recreation opportunity and visitor use

tasks.statement: Assign recreation opportunity classes to a planning area from setting characteristics, access and existing use
Estimate visitor use and capacity for a site from counts, permits and indicators of resource and social conditions
Designate motorized and non-motorized routes in a travel plan that separate conflicting uses and protect resources

majorDuties.duty: Provide first aid and emergency medical care in remote field settings

tasks.statement: Assess an injured or ill person in a remote location with a structured patient assessment, giving first aid within the scope of training
Coordinate a medical evacuation from a remote site, passing patient condition, location and landing or access information to responders
Inspect crew first aid and trauma kits on schedule, replacing expired or missing items and recording the check

majorDuties.duty: Communicate during field emergencies and report incidents

tasks.statement: Test field radios and satellite devices for a work area before deployment, programming channels and confirming coverage at key locations
Set the communication plan for a field operation, including check-in times, frequencies, escalation steps and overdue-person procedures
Troubleshoot field communication failures, switching to backup methods or relocating to restore contact within the check-in window

majorDuties.duty: Assess tree risk and structural condition

tasks.statement: Verify remote-sensed or analytics-flagged tree risk scores on the ground, recording each override with the field reason
Conduct a ground-based visual tree risk assessment, recording defects, likelihood of failure, targets and consequences on the standard form

majorDuties.duty: Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty

tasks.statement: Answer public questions about an uncertain environmental risk at a meeting or by phone using the current message map
Draft a public advisory that states the hazard, the people affected, the uncertainty and the protective action in plain language
Prepare a shared message map with partner agencies for an emerging environmental or health incident

majorDuties.duty: Manage risk in uncontrolled field environments

tasks.statement: Conduct a job hazard analysis at the actual work site before field activity begins, naming each hazard present and its control
Review an AI-drafted or template job hazard analysis against actual site conditions, adding missed hazards and removing ones that do not apply

majorDuties.duty: Monitor and steward wilderness character

tasks.statement: Establish a wilderness character baseline from indicator measures for each wilderness quality using available monitoring data
Monitor wilderness character indicators in the field to report trends against the baseline

majorDuties.duty: Assess and design for scenic resources

tasks.statement: Rate a proposed project's visual contrast from key observation points against the area's scenic objectives
Run a viewshed analysis from key observation points, checking modelled visibility at field locations

majorDuties.duty: Work alongside landowners, permittees, volunteers and communities on the land

tasks.statement: Adjust field plans on a landowner's property to their access conditions, livestock, crops or concerns raised on the day, recording the change
Explain field findings and their limits face to face to landowners or community members on site, answering questions about methods and uncertainty

majorDuties.duty: Construct and maintain trails to sustainable design standards

tasks.statement: Construct trail tread to the design grade, outslope and width from a flagged alignment, reading soils and drainage along the segment
Maintain existing trails by clearing drainage structures, brushing corridors and repairing tread before damage spreads

majorDuties.duty: Navigate and travel safely in remote terrain with and without digital aids

tasks.statement: Record field locations with a satellite positioning receiver to the protocol's accuracy, logging signal quality and averaging positions where required
Check field location data against field notes and maps before transfer, correcting or flagging points with implausible positions

bands.pctTimeNotice: % time: set by the supervisor; EMST supplies none before job analysis.
